channel.title: Luno incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Luno's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: Instant Buy not available in South Africa [identified]
item.description:
We have identified an issue that is affecting South African customers who attempt to buy cryptocurrency with the Instant Buy feature and receive an error.
Customers can still use instant deposit and EFT options to buy cryptocurrency.
We are working on this as a priority
